issues.title: Satellite Center: real WebUSB setRegBuffer failure, USB release verification & Meteor scheduled IQ diagnosis
issues.body:
## Scope / developer handoff (2026-11-07)
**Project:** Existing Tihulu Satellite Center browser/WebUSB + scheduler and native receiver integration, in `Tihulu/TIHULU-TEXT-CENTER`. This is a real-user RF capture diagnostic report for the active development chat/agent. **Do not restart the project; do not merge unrelated branches into `main`.** Related: #20 (device ownership/parity), #21 (Meteor/ISS receive-decode). Review this issue before declaring the web RF acquisition/release flow complete.

## Reproduced/observed facts
- Browser recording panel has `CU8` / `WAV` format selection, `Start real USB capture`, and `Stop & release`. Manual capture shows: `Capture stopped/failed: setRegBuffer failed block=0x1 reg=9f20. No satellite decoding is claimed.` Another observed failure from the web RF level measurement was `setRegBuffer failed block=0x1 reg=120`. Investigate device/backend register writes and actual teardown on any failure; **do not interpret this as weak satellite RF signal.**
- Scheduled **real WebUSB** capture did produce nonempty binary I/Q (not fake/synthetic): `TIHULU_METEOR-M2-4-CANDIDATE_20261107T014401Z_137900000Hz_1024000SPS_SCHEDULED-IQ.cu8`, local short name `~/meteor.cu8`. Verified file size **122,421,248 bytes** = **59.776 seconds** of unsigned interleaved 8-bit IQ at **1,024,000 complex samples/sec**. Paired WAV was labelled `48000SPS_SSTV-AUDIO`, but this is not Meteor LRPT (Meteor uses digital LRPT; SSTV audio does not prove satellite data).
- Second scheduled recording labelled `20261107T014601Z` was only **~2.18 seconds**. First recording starting `01:44:01Z` ends ~`01:45:01Z`, so there is ~60-second gap until second scheduled start. Investigate scheduling and aborted/short captures; if consecutive continuous coverage is requested, show and prevent gaps rather than silently dropping data.
- Offline SatDump **v1.2.2** read the CU8 input successfully with `satdump meteor_m2-x_lrpt baseband ~/meteor.cu8 <out> --samplerate 1024000 --baseband_format cu8 --dc_block --satellite_number M2-4` (72 ksym/s OQPSK) and separately `meteor_m2-x_lrpt_80k`. **Both produced zero-byte CADU**. 72k produced 0 MSU-MR image lines on channels 1–6, and no PNG/JPG. These results show **no successfully decoded Meteor data in this sample**, **not** proof of an intrinsically weak antenna or of an outright SDR hardware failure.
- SDR *did* capture variable IQ energy. Previous spectrum inspection did not distinguish a clear Meteor LRPT waveform at 137.900 MHz; an off-centre feature ~+340 kHz was present and is unclassified. Do not attribute it to a satellite without demodulator lock and validated frames.
- Offline SatDump decode did **not** open the SDR hardware. No confirmed evidence yet that the web app still holds the USB interface after stopping; browser UI stopping ≠ verified USB release.

## Required fixes / acceptance
1. **Reconcile manual vs scheduled paths:** use a consistent, known-working RTL-SDR/WebUSB initialization, tuner register configuration, gain/frequency/sample-rate setup, and error reporting. Test actual Pop!_OS RTL2832U/Nooelec unit, not simulated captures; investigate `setRegBuffer` errors and device reinitialization.
2. **Hardware state & ownership:** show `Disconnected / Connected / Capturing / Stopping / Released / Busy by another process / Error` grounded in actual USB/receiver state. Provide `Test receiver`, `Connect`, `Stop & release` and verify true closure. Use error-safe cleanup (cancel transfers, release claimed interface, close WebUSB device; native companion must close device handles/processes it owns). Do not kill other applications, do not claim 'released' merely because a button is grey.
3. **Scheduled recording integrity:** prove requested sample count and file duration, detect underruns/early abort, persist errors, clearly distinguish `scheduled`, `capturing`, `completed`, `partial`, `failed`. Continuous adjacent planned blocks should be gap-free when supported, or the UI must disclose exact gaps and backend limitations. Handle browser visibility and storage constraints honestly.
4. **RF signal evidence vs planned candidate:** show raw power/noise floor and estimated SNR (with caveats), centre frequency/sample rate/gain, actual recorded duration, satellite elevation and pass metadata; separately show decoder lock/sync, corrected/valid CADU/frames, products. Label planned targets `candidate / unverified` until **actual** decoded frames and protocol identification exist. Avoid fabricated SNR, geolocation or Earth images.
5. **Protocol workflow:** Meteor M2-x requires **LRPT decoder (72k/80k as appropriate)** on CU8/IQ, not an SSTV WAV pipeline. Add native SatDump handoff/optional decode for supported installations and make success/failure visible in the shared UI.
6. **Regression tests:** browser manual capture, scheduled capture, start/stop/restart/release, competing process ownership, partial captures, 60s+ recordings, 72k/80k zero-frame case, native receiver fallback. Keep all web & desktop/PWA functionality intact per #20.

## Repro data & expected outputs
User holds the original CU8/WAV files, a waterfall/spectrum diagnostic and SatDump logs locally; they are **not yet attached to GitHub**. Ask for them if needed; do not claim the issue contains the binary data. Local test result: 72k `meteor_m2-x_lrpt.cadu` = 0 B; 80k `meteor_m2-x_lrpt_80k.cadu` = 0 B.

**Priority:** Fix the reproducible WebUSB manual capture error + trustworthy release/status first. Then compare direct SatDump live acquisition against scheduled web capture on the **same actual pass, antenna and receiver settings** to isolate RF/antenna vs web acquisition faults. No conclusion of weak RF based solely on zero CADU.
issues.author: Tihulu

issues.title: Satellite Center: receive and decode public ISS/Meteor images, audio, video and data in one cross-platform tab
issues.body:
## Scope — continue existing Satellite Center, do not restart

User request (2026-11-06): a dedicated **Satellite Images & Data** tab shared across GitHub Pages, installed PWA, Linux/Pop!_OS, Raspberry Pi OS ARM, Windows x64 and macOS, to find ISS and other open-picture/audio/video/telemetry satellite transmissions; capture real RF and decode real Earth pictures when possible. Preserve ALL prior Satellite Center and Text Center features.

## Landed in draft branches and gh-pages
- [x] Separate `satellite_center/browser/reception.html` tab in both source branches (PR #9/#18) and published `gh-pages` branch.
- [x] One common `reception_catalog.mjs`: ISS SSTV, Meteor-M2-3/M2-4 LRPT, ISS voice/APRS, SatNOGS reference, NASA online imagery, retired NOAA POES archive. Frequency and current activity are **unverified candidates** until corroborated.
- [x] Reuse actual existing browser `satellite_images_ui.mjs` Robot36 WAV/CU8 candidate decoder (line synchronization required) and NASA on-demand gallery within the NEW tab; do not create a simulated receiver.
- [x] Local-only image/audio/video/text/TLE/CU8 preview, optional frequency + sample-rate metadata, labeled as user-imported/unverified, metadata-only JSON export.
- [x] Link mission/passes/decoder navigation to shared Satellite Center without starting USB or sending RF data. Native receiver dashboard has a link to the same tab.
- [x] Document Hauppauge WinTV-soloHD 01589 as DVB-T/T2/C TV tuner only, NOT an ISS/Meteor SDR; use the NESDR SMArt v5 with suitable antenna.
- [x] Retired NOAA-15/18/19 are archive-only; no fabricated APT live signal claim.
- [x] Add browser static/Node unit tests, platform CI checks, and include 4 tab assets in Pages/source parity checker (PR #18).
- [ ] CI and actual browser/manual hardware acceptance.

## Remaining implementation (do not mark completed prematurely)
- [ ] Connect true native SDR capture, owned-only stop, persistent pass scheduling and SatDump Meteor LRPT outputs into the new tab via authenticated local companion API. No silent USB takeover or leak of localhost bearer token.
- [ ] Add real RF-signal availability/source evidence; ARISS current station and scheduled event status must never be confused with TLE prediction.
- [ ] Add SatNOGS DB on-demand searchable transmitter/decoder catalog with proper CORS, rate-limit, caching, data provenance; differentiate modulation and licensed/private/encrypted cases. Do not infer content types from orbit or RF power.
- [ ] Additional open public protocols, image/audio/video/data decoder support **only if tested** with real captures; don't invent extraction of unrecognized CU8.
- [ ] Per-device receiver capability: USB permissions, WebUSB Chromium restrictions, local native fallback in Firefox/Safari, proper ARM/Windows/macOS native hardware acceptance, antennas by band and orbital Doppler.
- [ ] Confirm live Pages URL and PWA cache across release. Keep source browser assets byte-identical with published branch.
- [ ] Do not claim ISS provides continuous live Earth camera via ham SSTV; distinguish commemorative SSTV, Meteor weather Earth imagery, and NASA Internet archives.
- [ ] Demonstrate real RF capture → decode → save full images with attributable metadata; record independent decoder evidence.

## Sources
ARISS events: https://www.ariss.org/upcoming-sstv-events.html
ARISS station: https://www.ariss.org/current-status-of-iss-stations.html
SatDump LRPT pipeline: https://github.com/SatDump/SatDump.Docs/blob/master/pipelines.rst
SatNOGS public DB: https://db.satnogs.org/
Hauppauge specs: https://www.hauppauge.co.uk/site/products/data_solohd.html
NOAA POES retirement: https://www.nesdis.noaa.gov/news/suspension-of-poes-data-to-users-after-june-16-2025-and-decommissioning

Related cross-platform product contract: #20.

issues.title: Satellite Center: zero feature loss across Pages/PWA/Linux/Pi/Windows/macOS
issues.body:
## Requirement (2026-11-06)
Every Satellite Center entry point must expose the same feature set: GitHub Pages, installed PWA, Pop!_OS/Debian/Ubuntu, Raspberry Pi OS ARM32/ARM64, Windows x64, and macOS. **No feature may silently disappear on one platform.** Support optional local receiver adapters when browser APIs cannot perform an operation. Do not invent RF reception, decoded packets or satellite images.

Full contract: [satellite_center/FEATURE_PARITY.md](https://github.com/Tihulu/TIHULU-TEXT-CENTER/blob/feature/satellite-auto-discovery-integrated-2026-11-06/satellite_center/FEATURE_PARITY.md).

## Verified implementation/work done
- [x] Shared browser assets are served by the native companion at `/browser/index.html`.
- [x] Removed misleading “Satellite pass planner (web-only)” and “No local app” UI labels from both satellite source branches and `gh-pages`.
- [x] Added direct optional local receiver/decoder link to the shared page.
- [x] Added a static test for planner controls and same-origin companion asset route.
- [x] Added a CI guard (source PR #18) comparing 12 critical published `gh-pages` assets to the reviewed browser bundle.

## Open release blockers / acceptance (do not mark complete without evidence)
- [ ] Unify direct WebUSB and optional native SDR under the **same user-visible receiver workflow**, including status, Stop/Hard Stop, owned-only shutdown and device contention handling, without hiding native features behind unrelated screens.
- [ ] Expose native persistent scheduling, real captures, archives, SatDump Meteor LRPT and appropriate APRS decode through the common UI when the authenticated local companion is available.
- [ ] Preserve equivalent feature availability in Firefox/Safari by an explicit companion fallback; direct browser WebUSB itself is Chromium-only, and a static site cannot bypass this restriction.
- [ ] Support secure authenticated LAN/mobile access to the receiver, avoiding treating a remote PC as the phone's `localhost` and never exposing the pairing secret in a public URL.
- [ ] Verify Pop!_OS actual RTL2832U, Raspberry Pi ARM32/ARM64, Windows x64 and macOS native capture paths with hardware. Synthetic CI is not hardware acceptance.
- [ ] Verify GitHub Pages live deployment, PWA update/cache behavior and independent Windows/macOS/Linux/Pi entry points after each publication.
- [ ] Confirm every shared workflow is reachable from all entry points, without removing existing Satellite Images, full CU8 scanning, waterfall, Earth/Sky map, GPS, TLE import, scheduled reception or real-source attribution.
- [ ] Review offline operation with previously cached TLEs and local files (including JS/vendor assets) and user-approved catalog refresh.

## Safety
No hidden SDR scan, no automatic takeover from readsb/welle.io, no fabricated RF attribution, no background receiver after owned process exit. Keep existing recordings safe. Keep PR #9 and PR #18 in draft until real platform acceptance and integration; `gh-pages` publication is not proof of native parity.

issues.title: Implement antenna-first real RF channel discovery and text decoders (not just spectrum peaks)
issues.body:
## Why
The present Text Center correctly separates **Local Board (600)** from **Radio Data (400)** and **Protocols (860)**. The repository now has passive USB/decoder discovery, seven catalogued RF band profiles, an FM/DAB/APRS VHF **energy** survey, manual `rtl_fm | redsea` RDS capture and short FM audio previews. However, an energy peak is **not** an identified channel, and most requested text protocols still cannot be decoded directly from the antenna. The user needs an antenna-first workflow, not a list of Internet links.

## Priority / implementation plan
- [ ] **P0 UI/flow:** Radio Data (400) should clearly lead with **Discover receivers → scan available band → verify/decode actual stations/services → browse received text → archive offline**. Keep Local Board (600) available but explicitly separate from RF reception. Show a per-feature state: *passive-only*, *energy scan*, *decoder-ready*, *live received*, *busy*, *dependency missing*, or *blocked*. Never relabel spectrum peaks as stations.
- [ ] **P0 FM:** Feed genuinely detected candidate frequencies into explicit sequential/user-approved `rtl_fm + redsea` verification (with cancellation, duration budget and physical receiver lease). Extract received PS, PI, RadioText, RT+ tags, PTY and available traffic flags without inventing missing metadata. Preserve original texts and timestamps. Keep existing audio previews, if present, on the same tuner lock.
- [ ] **P1 DAB Band III:** Integrate a verified welle-compatible DAB ensemble/service search and live DLS/DLS+ metadata. Separately gate Journaline, MOT Slideshow, EPG/SPI and TPEG behind actual decoder output and licensing/rights. A power survey alone is insufficient.
- [ ] **P1 DVB-T2:** Use the *separate* DVB-T2 frontend, a user-region tuning table, protected DVB tuner lease and transport-stream/PID parser; enumerate real muxes/services and Teletext pages/subpages. Keep HbbTV/web-based Teletext separately labelled Internet-only. Do not interrupt TV recordings.
- [ ] **P2 APRS/AX.25:** Add authorized receive-only packet decoding via appropriate VHF narrowband demodulation and decoder, with public-data privacy handling; do not add TX.
- [ ] **P2 LF/HF (DRM, RTTY, NAVTEX, WeatherFAX):** Require actual compatible LF/HF antenna and validated Q-branch scanner/demodulator for NESDR SMArt v5. Stock osmocom `rtl_power -D` selects I-branch and cannot be claimed as v5 Q-branch support; see draft PR #1. Provide correct low-frequency scan/decoder adapters and real reception evidence before enabling.
- [ ] **P2 archive:** Search/filter received content by protocol, frequency, actual station/PI/service, time, original text, provenance and online/offline state. Offline means **previously received/cached**, not a new signal without a tuned antenna.
- [ ] **Integration:** Use authoritative Tihulu Survival Kit Stage-4 shared SDR/DVB lease broker; do not kill or retune Flight Radar/readsb, `rtl_433`, Gqrx, welle.io or recordings. Background RF/network polling default **OFF**; preserve low-memory Pi operation and responsive phone/tablet/desktop portal through authenticated TLS.

## Acceptance gates
1. **Unit/CI:** Synthetic parsers and mock subprocesses, no speculative proof of RF reception; preserve current test suite.
2. **Pop!_OS hardware:** Record exactly which USB IDs, Linux tool versions, antenna, source frequency, timestamps and actual decoded service data were validated on Nooelec NESDR SMArt v5 (USB 0bda:2838). Verify tuner contention and stop/timeout behavior. Run separate DVB frontend acceptance.
3. **Offline:** Unplug WAN, receive a genuine local RF signal and display newly decoded text without fetching any Internet site; clearly report when a given broadcaster transmits no text.
4. **Resource/security:** No automatic RF TX, no false official alerts, no protected recording preemption, bounded captures; confirm browser and Pi memory/CPU use.
5. **UI:** Make Radio Data and Protocols scan controls easy to find; the Local Board is not represented as an antenna channel.

## Existing contracts
- [Scanning modes](docs/SCANNING_MODES.md)
- [Master Survival Kit handoff](docs/SURVIVAL_KIT_MASTER_PROMPT.md)
- [FM RDS capture guide](docs/FM_RDS_LIVE.md)
- [HF Q-branch corrective draft PR](https://github.com/Tihulu/TIHULU-TEXT-CENTER/pull/1)

**Done does not mean catalogue presence.** Mark any unvalidated hardware feature **PENDING** or **BLOCKED**, not implemented. Existing functional modules must not regress.
